## Item 7 — Notification settings (user controls for alerts) (carried from v1.6.5)

- **Status:** **DONE `27693d5`** (2026-07-17, Sonnet, low effort), on-device verified (emulator, Claude driving at Alvin's request). Non-paywall (free). No schema/Room change (stays **v26**). Carried over from [v1.6.5.md](v1.6.5.md) Item 7 (moved 2026-07-14, not yet built).
- **Request:** originally booked from the v1.6.5 Settings-gap sweep — there's no user control over the app's existing notifications. Re-confirmed with Alvin 2026-07-17 with scope narrowed to the toggle screen only (the payday-reminder tangent from Item 37 split to Item 40 below, pending its own grill).
- **Why:** budget alerts already fire ([BudgetAlertNotifier](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/presentation/BudgetAlertNotifier.kt), dedup via [BudgetAlertStore](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/data/BudgetAlertStore.kt)), but there is **no user toggle anywhere** — you can't turn it off.
- **Scope note (2026-07-17):** Item 37's Q14 grill deferred a *payday/bill due-date reminder* notification to "fast-follow" here. That's **split out to [Item 40](#item-40--payday-bill-due-date-reminder-notification-needs-grill)** instead — it needs new scheduled-notification infra and a design call the Item 37 grill flagged but didn't resolve (it cuts against the foreground-sync-only philosophy Item 36 just reaffirmed).
- **Correction (2026-07-17): the "couple activity" toggle is dropped.** [CoupleBell](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/sync/CoupleBell.kt) does **not** post a system notification — verified by grepping the whole app for `NotificationCompat`/`NotificationManager`, which turns up only `BudgetAlertNotifier`. `CoupleBell.pings` feeds `CoupleChannelManager`, which triggers a silent background pull; nothing user-visible exists on that path. A toggle for it would gate nothing. This item is now scoped to **Budget alerts only** — a real couple-activity notification is a separate, unbooked feature if ever wanted.

**Change (as built):** new **Notifications** sub-screen ([NotificationsScreen.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/settings/presentation/NotificationsScreen.kt)/`NotificationsViewModel`/`NotificationsUiState`), reached from a new row in [PersonalizeScreen.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/settings/presentation/PersonalizeScreen.kt) (between Security and Couple) and routed via a new `settings_notifications` composable in [IponApp.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/navigation/IponApp.kt). One DataStore-backed toggle — **Budget alerts** on/off, default **on** — via a new `NotificationPreferencesRepository`/`Impl` (mirrors `BudgetStartDayRepositoryImpl`, riding the existing `finance_prefs` DataStore + `ObserveBudgetAlertsEnabledUseCase`/`SetBudgetAlertsEnabledUseCase`) bound in `SettingsModule`. [BudgetAlertWorker](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/worker/BudgetAlertWorker.kt) now reads the pref once per run and, when off, still calls `alertStore.markFired(...)` for every crossed threshold but skips `notifier.fire(...)` — so re-enabling later doesn't dump a backlog of stale alerts.
- **POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission — decided (2026-07-17): left as-is.** It's already requested unconditionally at cold start ([MainActivity.kt:123-125](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/MainActivity.kt#L123-L125)); moving it to be contextual (only on toggle-on) would touch `MainActivity`'s startup flow for a cosmetic UX improvement, outside this item's low-effort scope. Not a blocker — Android silently no-ops `notify()` when the permission is denied either way.
- **Scope correction (2026-07-17, pre-build):** the originally-planned "Couple activity" toggle was dropped — see the correction note above. `CoupleBell` posts no system notification, so there was nothing for that toggle to gate.

**Verify:** `assembleStagingDebug` + `testStagingDebugUnitTest` green. No new tier-1 tests — the new usecases/repo are trivial DataStore pass-throughs and the worker gate is a one-line orchestration check, matching the no-test precedent for sibling toggle slices (Items 15/25/34: "flag/lifecycle wiring, verified by running"). **On-device verified** (emulator, Claude driving at Alvin's request, 2026-07-17): Notifications row confirmed between Security and Couple, default ON; toggle OFF + cross 80% on a budget → confirmed via `adb shell dumpsys notification` that nothing posted, and via the pulled `budget_alert_prefs` DataStore file that the 80% key was still marked fired (silent suppression, not silent dropping); toggle back ON with no new spend + relaunch → still no notification (proves re-enabling doesn't dump a backlog of stale alerts); crossed 100% on the same budget with toggle ON → "Dates limit reached" fired correctly; a fresh 80% crossing on an untouched budget with toggle ON fired normally ("Electricity at 80%") — confirms the regular path is unaffected; toggle state persisted correctly across two full app relaunches (force-stop + cold start, since `BudgetAlertWorker` only re-runs on login or a completed background `SyncWorker` cycle, not a plain foreground resume). All test budgets/transactions/notifications created for verification were cleaned up afterward.

## Item 40 — Payday / bill due-date reminder notification (needs grill)

- **Status:** ⏸️ **NOT DESIGNED — needs a grill before booking to build.** Split out of [Item 7](#item-7--notification-settings-user-controls-for-alerts-carried-from-v165) 2026-07-17. **Model (once grilled): TBD** — likely Opus, since it's cross-cutting with the sync architecture, not a pattern-follow.
- **Origin:** [Item 37](#item-37--confirm-on-arrival-recurring--incomebill-forecasting) Q14 — Alvin's payday-visibility request surfaced a "should there be a reminder notification" question that the grill deliberately deferred rather than resolve inline.
- **The open design tension:** a scheduled due-date reminder needs new local-notification infra (likely `AlarmManager`/`WorkManager`-based date scheduling) — but the app's whole sync/background posture is deliberately foreground-only (interactive sync runs in-process; ADR-0012; Item 36 just declined periodic background sync for the balance widget on the same philosophy). Whether a payday reminder is worth the exception, and if so what mechanism respects it (e.g. a lightweight local `AlarmManager` alarm that doesn't touch sync/network, vs. WorkManager periodic), is unresolved.
- **Not a blocker for Item 7** — the Records "To confirm" card (Item 37 Slice 1, shipped) already surfaces pending occurrences on next app open without this.

## Item 35 — Unify the couple budget into the real Budgets feature (supersedes the "remove it" plan)

- **Status:** **DONE `4190803`** (2026-07-17, Opus, on-device verified) — **replacing** the prior "remove the shared/joint couple budget" scope (originally booked 2026-07-15, never built). **GRILLED 2026-07-17** (design resolved below). **Model: Opus, high effort** — multi-ADR (budgets, rollover ADR-0036, couple-sharing ADR-0008/0011, entitlement cap-scope) + couple-shared state + the combined-spend stream wiring; a new **ADR-0047** records the deliberate divergence from the ADR-0018 toggle pattern. **No schema/Supabase migration; Room stays v26** (the grill's key result — see the Path-B decision).
- **Origin:** Alvin, re-litigating Item 35 — the instinct to rip the couple budget out was really a reaction to the *implementation* being weak (single overall-only limit, no categories, no rollover, manually re-set every month, living as a bespoke card on the Combined screen) rather than the *concept* being wrong. `budgets.coupleId` has existed since V1 and was never used for anything beyond this one blunt card, while personal budgets grew categories + rollover on the same table. **Product call:** don't delete couple budgeting — fold it into the existing Budgets feature so shared budgets get categories + rollover and become first-class rows in Manage → Budgets, editing in one place.

**Grill decisions (2026-07-17):**
1. **Share model — creation-time selector, NOT a post-hoc toggle (Path B).** The budget editor gains a **Personal / Shared** selector, shown only when paired, chosen at creation; **a budget's scope is immutable after creation** (edit amount/rollover/category, not scope — to change scope, delete + recreate, or "duplicate to next month" and pick the other scope). This deliberately **diverges** from the Accounts/Categories/Goals "Share with partner / Make personal" row toggle (ADR-0018), because budgets are structurally different: a budget is a **per-month row** (`yearMonth`), so a post-hoc toggle would force re-sharing every month and could mix rollover-chain scopes; and the toggle's revert-to-creator needs a `created_by` column budgets don't have. Path B needs **no `created_by`, no Room migration (stays v26), no ADR-0008 change** — shared budgets are born joint (as today), either partner edits, and unpair **soft-deletes** them per ADR-0008 unchanged. → **new ADR-0047** records this divergence + rationale.
2. **Cap — new `maxSharedBudgets`, Scope.SHARED, per-month, gated at shared-budget creation** (mirrors `CheckAccountCapUseCase(shared)`). Values **FREE = 1, PREMIUM = 50** (mirrors `maxSharedAccounts`). Rename the existing `maxBudgets` → **`maxPersonalBudgets`** for symmetry with the other three pairs. Closes the current gap where shared budgets are silently *uncapped* (`CombinedViewModel.saveBudget` gates nothing today, and the "shared budgets have their own limits" doc claim in `CheckBudgetCapUseCase` was false — no such field ever existed). Dormant until enforcement flips, like every other cap.
3. **Combined-screen card → read-only summary.** Replace the editable `CoupleBudgetCard` (single overall number) + `BudgetEditorDialog` with a **read-only** summary card listing the couple's shared budgets' progress, tapping through to the Budgets tab; **self-hides when there are no shared budgets**. All shared-budget creation/editing moves to Manage → Budgets — the Combined screen keeps couple-context *visibility* only (ADR-0011: the couple screen is where you glance at "how are we doing").
4. **Spend counting.** A shared budget's progress counts **both partners' combined non-private spending** in that category/month (via `ObserveCombinedTransactionsUseCase`, the same stream the Combined view already uses); personal budgets keep counting own transactions only. Consequence (correct + consistent with ADR-0011): **a transaction marked Private never counts toward a shared budget.**
5. **Rollover — per-row toggle verbatim on shared rows, no couple-agreement gate.** `BudgetProgressCalculator` is already scope-agnostic (purely per-row, chained by `categoryId` + consecutive `yearMonth`); a shared row just gets the same toggle. The carry uses the **combined** spent (falls out of #4), and the chain stays **within one scope** (shared chains with shared) — kept consistent by #1's immutable scope + duplicate-forward-carries-the-flag. No ADR-0036 change, just its application widened to shared rows.
6. **Migration — none.** No schema/Supabase change (opposite of the old "remove it" plan: `coupleId`, `budgets_couple` RLS, `budget_owner_chk`, `idx_budgets_couple`, and the unpair soft-delete step all **stay**). Staging's 1 live shared-budget row (couple-owned, no-category) is **already a valid overall shared budget** under this model — kept as a live test fixture.

**Change (client-side only — no schema/Room/Supabase migration):**
- **Budgets tab — show personal + shared together:** [BudgetsViewModel.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/presentation/BudgetsViewModel.kt) observes **both** `observeBudgets()` (personal, `coupleId IS NULL`) and `observeSharedBudgets(coupleId)` (when paired), merged into one list; spend per row picks the stream by scope — personal → `ObserveTransactionsUseCase` (own), shared → `ObserveCombinedTransactionsUseCase` (both, non-private). [Budget.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/domain/model/Budget.kt) gains an `isShared`/scope field (and fix its stale "V1 budgets are all personal" doc comment) so the row can badge + the VM can pick the stream. [BudgetsScreen.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/presentation/BudgetsScreen.kt) `BudgetsBody` renders a `core/ui/SharedBadge` on shared rows (one flat list, badge-per-row — matching the Accounts precedent); the editor dialog gains the **Personal/Shared selector** (paired-only, creation-only). `saveBudget` routes shared → `UpsertSharedBudgetUseCase` (exists) + `checkBudgetCap(shared = true)`, personal → `UpsertBudgetUseCase` + `checkBudgetCap(shared = false)`.
- **Cap:** [PlanLimits.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/entitlement/PlanLimits.kt) rename `maxBudgets`→`maxPersonalBudgets`, add `maxSharedBudgets` (FREE 1 / PREMIUM 50) — update both tier tables, the `PlanLimitsOverrides` mirror + `applyOverrides` (the §11 finding-#3 hand-linked pair). [BudgetDao.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/data/local/BudgetDao.kt) add `countShared(coupleId, yearMonth)` (mirrors `AccountDao.countShared`); [BudgetRepository.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/domain/repository/BudgetRepository.kt)/Impl add `countSharedBudgets`. [CheckBudgetCapUseCase.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/domain/usecase/CheckBudgetCapUseCase.kt) gains a `shared: Boolean` branch (Scope.SHARED + `countSharedBudgets` + `maxSharedBudgets` vs Scope.INDIVIDUAL + `countPersonalBudgets` + `maxPersonalBudgets`); fix its false doc comment. Wire `raiseUpsell("shared_budgets", …)` at shared-create.
- **Combined view — read-only summary:** [CombinedViewModel.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/couple/presentation/CombinedViewModel.kt) replace the single `coupleBudget` (overall combined spend) with a **list** of shared budgets + per-budget combined-spend progress (reuse `BudgetProgressCalculator` over the combined stream); drop the editor methods (`startEditBudget`/`saveBudget`/`clearBudget`/`onBudgetAmountChange`/`cancelBudgetEdit`). [CombinedUiState.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/couple/presentation/CombinedUiState.kt) `coupleBudget: CoupleBudgetUi?` → `sharedBudgets: List<…>` (read-only), drop `budgetEditor`/`BudgetEditorState`. [CombinedScreen.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/couple/presentation/CombinedScreen.kt) replace `CoupleBudgetCard` + `BudgetEditorDialog` with a read-only summary card (self-hides when empty; tap → switch to Manage → Budgets, `switchTab` intent-extra precedent from the widget deep-link).
- **Kept unchanged (opposite of the old plan):** `budgets.coupleId` column, `observeSharedBudgets`/`upsertSharedBudget`/`purgeSharedBudgets`, `deleteCoupleBudgets` (unpair purge), the flip-model push-ownership filter in [BudgetTableSyncer.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/data/sync/BudgetTableSyncer.kt), the `budgets_couple` RLS + `budget_owner_chk` + `idx_budgets_couple` + `unpair()` soft-delete step — all stay. `BudgetAlertWorker`'s shared-budget branch **stays** (shared budgets still fire alerts; verify the alert copy reads sensibly for a category-scoped shared budget).
- **Docs:** new **ADR-0047** (budget unification: shared via creation selector, immutable scope, deliberate divergence from ADR-0018's toggle + why; no `created_by`); amend **ADR-0011** (shared budgets now edited in the Budgets tab, Combined shows a read-only summary) and note **ADR-0036** scope widened to shared rows. Update the CLAUDE.md V1-Scope line "Shared couple budget (joint monthly budget)" → per-category shared budgets in the Budgets tab (not removed).

**Verify:** tier-1 JVM tests **required** (cap + money + calculator logic): `CheckBudgetCapUseCase` shared/personal branches (dormant bypass, free block-at-cap, premium bypass, shared partner-unlock — mirror `PremiumGateTest`/`CheckAccountCapUseCase` cases); `PlanLimits` `maxSharedBudgets` resolve + tier-scoped overrides; `BudgetProgressCalculator` fed combined-spend inputs for a shared row incl. a rollover chain staying within scope; the BudgetsViewModel personal+shared merge (extract the merge/scope-pick as a pure helper so it's JVM-testable without the VM harness). Keep + extend the existing shared-budget tests (`ObserveSharedBudgetUseCaseTest`, `BudgetRepositoryImplTest`, `BudgetTableSyncerTest`, `BudgetTestFixtures.kt`, `CoupleTestFixtures.kt`) rather than deleting them. `testStagingDebugUnitTest` + `assembleStagingDebug` green. **On-device (Alvin, paired staging accounts** — testdev17 + testdev15 per `test-account-credentials`, since this is couple-shared): create a shared budget (with a category + rollover) from the Budgets tab on one device → confirm it appears with a Shared badge on **both** devices, its progress counts **both** partners' non-private spending, a Private transaction is excluded, rollover carries combined spend forward, the Combined view shows the read-only summary (and self-hides with no shared budgets), and the `maxSharedBudgets` cap fires at creation under a temporary staging `enforcement_enabled` flip (flip back to dormant after).

**As built (2026-07-17, Opus — build green, on-device pass still to do):**
- **New:** `ObserveCombinedTransactionsForBudgetsUseCase` + `TransactionDao.observeCombinedUnbounded()` / repo `observeCombinedTransactionsUnbounded()` (unbounded both-partner non-private ledger — shared-budget spend needs prior months for the rollover chain, unlike the month-windowed combined stream); pure `BudgetRowsCalculator` (the merge/scope-pick helper: personal→own txns, shared→combined txns, chains within scope, shared=calendar); `BudgetDao.countShared(yearMonth)`.
- **Cap gate moved to save-time.** Scope is only known once the editor picks Personal/Shared, so the new-budget cap check runs in `save()` (and per-scope in `duplicateToNextMonth`), not at create-intent as personal budgets did before. Editing an existing row is never gated. `upsellSource` tracks `"budgets"` vs `"shared_budgets"` so the §10.10 touchpoint logs the right key.
- **`upsertBudget` made ownership-preserving** — editing an existing shared row keeps it couple-owned (never re-stamps `user_id`, which would violate `budget_owner_chk`); `reset rollover` rides this unchanged; `duplicate` routes shared→`upsertSharedBudget` explicitly.
- **`BudgetAlertWorker` correctness fix (folded in):** shared-budget alerts now check the **combined** ledger (was the user's own transactions) so an alert matches the new both-partner spend model.
- **Shared budgets use calendar months** (`BudgetRowsCalculator.CALENDAR_START_DAY`), personal honour the payday `startDay` (ADR-0046) — a jointly-owned budget can't follow one partner's personal start day. Preserves pre-Item-35 behaviour.
- **Deviation from the grill's "tap through to Budgets":** the Combined read-only summary is **non-navigating** — it shows a "Manage shared budgets in the Budgets tab" caption instead of a tap-through, because there's no existing Manage sub-tab deep-link mechanism and building one (cross-graph nav + a ManageScreen `initialTab`) was disproportionate for a read-only glance. Trivial follow-up if wanted later.
- **No schema/Room change (stays v26), no Supabase migration** — `couple_id`/RLS/constraint/index/unpair-soft-delete all kept (opposite of the old removal plan). New **ADR-0047**; amended ADR-0011/0036/0046; CLAUDE.md V1-scope line updated.
- **Tests:** +`CheckBudgetCapUseCaseTest` (7 cases), +`BudgetRowsCalculatorTest` (4), +`PlanLimitsTest` shared-override case, +`BudgetMapperTest` `isShared` projection; fakes extended (`countShared`, `observeCombinedUnbounded`, `countSharedBudgets`, `observeCombinedTransactionsUnbounded`). `testStagingDebugUnitTest` + `assembleStagingDebug` green.

**On-device verified (2026-07-17, emulator, Claude driving on a real paired staging couple — testdev-couple `31b0580e`):** the pre-existing shared Overall budget rendered as a first-class Budgets-tab row with a "Shared" badge; created a new shared **Groceries** budget via the Personal/Shared selector + rollover on → confirmed in Room it was couple-owned (`userId` NULL, `couple_id` set) and pushed to staging (RLS accepted). Combined-spend proven by DB cross-check: the Overall shared budget's spend = **₱9,381** = both partners' non-private July expense (me ₱1,534 + partner ₱7,847, ~20% bar), **not** the personal-only ₱1,534 (~3%) — private excluded by construction. Combined view showed the **read-only** summary (both shared budgets + "Manage shared budgets in the Budgets tab." caption, no edit controls) and **self-hid** in June (no shared budget). Editing a shared budget showed the immutable-scope "Shared" badge (not the selector). Under a temporary staging `enforcement_enabled` flip: the `maxSharedBudgets` cap fired at creation — "Free includes up to **1** shared budgets. Go Premium for up to **50**." — with freeze holding (existing 2 untouched); the rollover S9 lock also engaged (other gates undisturbed). Enforcement flipped back OFF and all test data restored (Overall → ₱50,000, Groceries deleted) + synced to staging afterward.

## Item 36 — Balance-widget reliability: dead eye/⟳ taps, stale balance, picker "Can't load widget"

- **Status:** **DONE `98a9dfe`** (on-device verified by Alvin, 2026-07-16). Booked 2026-07-16 (grilled same day). **Model: Opus, high effort** — cross-cutting Glance/process-lifecycle debugging on the v1.6.5 Item 32/33 widget; the picker-preview fix alone is Sonnet-trivial, but the interactivity/staleness legs need on-device root-causing. No Room/schema change expected (stays **v25**).
- **Request:** Alvin — "widget balance is sooo buggy, slow to sync, or doesn't sync at all; sometimes the eye button is functional, most of the time it's not responding; minor: opening widgets says *cannot load widget* but user is able to add it as a widget." Grill (2026-07-16) narrowed the symptoms: staleness = **own in-app changes** not showing on the widget + **⟳ not updating**; eye = **nothing happens even after 10s+** (not merely late); the load error is the **widget-picker preview card only** (the placed widget renders fine). Product call from the grill: **⟳ should trigger a real sync**, not stay local-only; periodic background sync declined for now.

**Root causes found (code inspection, 2026-07-16):**
1. **Picker preview — CONFIRMED:** [balance_widget_preview.xml](../../app/src/main/res/layout/balance_widget_preview.xml) draws its three account color dots with bare `<View>` tags; `View` is not in the RemoteViews whitelist, so the API-31+ picker fails to inflate `previewLayout` and shows "Can't load widget" as the preview. Runtime is Glance-drawn, so adding works — exactly the reported split.
2. **Eye/⟳ dead:** both are Glance `ActionCallback` broadcasts that must start (or thaw) the app process; on the Transsion/MTK ROM (aggressive freeze/force-stop — the same behavior documented in Item 33's onStop-repaint fix) the broadcast is dropped or deferred, so "sometimes works" = process happened to be warm. In-code aggravators: every re-render blocks in [BalanceWidget.kt:95](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/BalanceWidget.kt#L95) on an up-to-**8s** Supabase auth-status wait (a timeout misreads a logged-in user as signed out → hard-mask, eye vanishes); and any concurrent data refresh ([Widgets.updateAll](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/Widgets.kt) — e.g. the privacy grace-elapse ~30s after backgrounding) resets a fresh peek to masked.
3. **Stale balance:** the widget only paints local Room. [RefreshBalanceWidgetAction](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/RefreshBalanceWidgetAction.kt) is deliberately no-network, and after the single post-login [SyncWorker](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/sync/SyncWorker.kt) run there is **no background sync at all** (one-shot `KEEP` enqueue at login; no periodic/reconnect re-arm; the couple bell is foreground-only) — so nothing can move the figure while the app is backgrounded except the 30-min repaint tick (ROM-throttled, and it repaints the same local data anyway). The write-path repaints themselves (`Widgets.updateAll` after each commit, completing *before* navigation) look correct statically — the "own changes don't show" leg still needs on-device confirmation (prime suspect: Glance's WorkManager-backed session being deferred by the ROM freeze).

**Change (grilled shape):**
- **A. Preview fix (certain):** replace the three `<View>` dots with `ImageView` + an oval shape drawable (RemoteViews-safe) in [balance_widget_preview.xml](../../app/src/main/res/layout/balance_widget_preview.xml).
- **B. ⟳ = real sync (Alvin's call):** [RefreshBalanceWidgetAction](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/RefreshBalanceWidgetAction.kt) keeps its immediate local repaint, then enqueues an **expedited** `SyncWorker` (`CONNECTED` constraint, `RUN_AS_NON_EXPEDITED_WORK_REQUEST` fallback) — reusing its existing sync → widget-repaint → budget-alert chain; manual sync in the ADR-0002 spirit. Skip the enqueue when signed out. Accepted at grill: the post-sync repaint resets a peek (data-refresh semantics).
- **C. Kill the auth stall:** persist a `has_session` hint (DataStore) written at every `AuthStatus` transition, so `provideGlance` reads session state instantly instead of blocking up to 8s on Supabase cold init; keep a short live-read fallback only when the hint has never been written. Removes both the tap latency and the timeout→hard-mask misread.
- **D. Instrument + on-device root-cause the dead-tap/stale leg:** `Log.i` (the ROM drops `Log.d`) at every refresh trigger → `provideGlance` entry → resolve, plus both action callbacks; drive per `/ondevice` on Alvin's device; decide from evidence whether a Glance 1.1.0→1.1.1 bump and/or per-instance `update(context, id)` (verify the real 1.1.0 API via `javap` first — the in-code "single-instance update() isn't exposed" comment) is warranted. A battery-optimization-exemption hint screen (the only real cure for force-stop) is a **separate product call, not booked here**.
- **E. Uniform widget colors (Alvin, 2026-07-16 — "make all the widgets uniform… balance consistent with add transaction"):** grill call was **both theme-aware Rose**, not the literal "balance adopts Add Txn's fixed pink." [AddTransactionWidget](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/AddTransactionWidget.kt) dropped its hardcoded `#FFD9E3` bg / `#9F3758` text (which never flipped for dark mode) and now wraps in the same `GlanceTheme(colors = IponWidgetColors)` the balance widget already uses (`widgetBackground` / `primary` / `onSurfaceVariant`), so both widgets follow the system night mode and read as one set.
- **F. Fresh-setup population latency (Alvin, 2026-07-16 — "freshly install, sign in, create the widget… takes so long to populate… idk what triggered it"):** confirmed structural gap — neither widget receiver reacts to being added (Glance renders `provideGlance` once against Room-at-that-instant), onboarding never repaints widgets, and the only post-sign-in repaint is the one-shot `LaunchedEffect(userId)` that runs *before* onboarding creates accounts; after that the reliable repaints are onStop / SyncWorker / the 30-min tick. C already removes the ≤8s `provideGlance` stall that likely dominated the add-time delay; on top, [MainActivity](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/MainActivity.kt) now repaints after the **foreground onResume sync** (symmetric with the existing onStop repaint) and once the **main app mounts** post-onboarding (`LaunchedEffect(Unit)` in the `false` branch). No sync-on-`onUpdate` (that would be the periodic background sync Alvin declined). "Can't tell" on the trigger → the D instrumentation confirms on-device.
- **Explicitly unchanged:** the mask model ([resolveWidgetDisplay](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/WidgetDisplay.kt)), Item 25's session-privacy semantics, no periodic background sync.

**Follow-up fix G — "No accounts yet" on a cold process (Alvin on-device, 2026-07-16):** after granting the Item 38 exemption, the widget synced then flipped to "No accounts yet". Root cause: `provideGlance` read the user-scoped account/net-assets flows (`AccountRepositoryImpl.observeAccounts` emits `emptyList()` when `CurrentUserProvider.currentUserOrNull()` is null) **before** the Supabase session finishes restoring on a cold process — so the accounts read empty while the new cached session hint said logged in, surfacing the empty state that the old 8s hard-mask used to hide. Fix: resolve the session hint first (mask/eye stays instant), then — when logged in — `withTimeoutOrNull(SESSION_LOAD_MS=8s) { status.first { it is Authenticated } }` **before** reading accounts, so the reads see the real user id; a warm process is already Authenticated → instant, and Glance keeps the prior render visible during any cold-start wait (no flash of empty). Instrumentation now logs `accounts=N`. Emulator can't reproduce the race (session restores in ~30ms there) but confirmed no regression: warm + cold both log `accounts=7`. **The real proof is Alvin's device** (watch for `hasSession=true accounts=0` → the race; with the fix it should read the real count).

**Status of the build — DONE `98a9dfe` (2026-07-16):** A + B + C + E + F + G **built, `testStagingDebugUnitTest` (+5 new `WidgetSessionTest` cases) + `assembleStagingDebug` green.** **Emulator-verified (2026-07-16, tfvin24, no test data created — widget placed via an `input motionevent` DOWN-hold-MOVE-UP drag since a plain swipe just opens the app drawer):** **A** — the balance widget's picker preview renders ("Net assets ₱42,350.00" + green/blue account dots), no "Can't load widget"; **E** — the quick-add widget flips to a dark surface + rose accent under system dark mode (was fixed pink), matching the balance widget; **C** — the placed widget shows soft-mask + eye (session read correctly, **not** hard-masked → the 8s-stall fix), and the eye reveals ₱375,400.00; **B** — one ⟳ tap logged `onAction received → signedIn=true enqueuing expedited sync → WM Starting SyncWorker → provideGlance resolved hasSession=true seedHint=null` (real sync + instant hint read, no probe). The instrumentation (D) prints cleanly, so on Alvin's device a *gap* in that same chain will pinpoint where the ROM drops the tap. The remaining symptoms (eye/⟳ *lag*, *dead* taps, *slow* populate) are the ROM freezing the process — by construction not reproducible on clean Android, which keeps the process alive; **Item 38's battery-opt exemption was reverted** (the OEM killer ignores Doze); the widget was made self-sufficient on a cold respawn instead (esp. G). **Alvin's on-device pass 2026-07-16: working well.** The temporary D instrumentation (`WIDGET_LOG_TAG` / `TODO(Item 36)`) was **stripped** before commit. New files: `feature/widget/data/WidgetSessionStore.kt`, `WidgetSession.kt` (pure resolver), `WidgetSessionHintWriter.kt` (started from `IponApp`), `res/drawable/widget_preview_dot.xml`; `widget_prefs` DataStore added to `WidgetModule`. No Room/schema change (stays **v25**).

**Verify:** tier-1 JVM tests for the new pure session-hint resolution logic (done); `testStagingDebugUnitTest` + `assembleStagingDebug` green (done); on-device (Alvin, real device per his usual pass): picker preview renders without the error card; eye responds warm **and** cold; ⟳ pulls a change made from a second account/device; add a transaction in-app → home → widget shows the new figure; both widgets share one look in light **and** dark mode; a widget added right after a fresh sign-in populates promptly.

## Item 38 — Battery-optimization exemption prompt ❌ REVERTED (didn't work on the target ROM)

- **Status:** ❌ **REVERTED 2026-07-16, uncommitted** — built + emulator-verified end-to-end, then **backed out entirely** after Alvin's on-device test. **Model was: Sonnet, medium effort.**
- **Request:** Alvin — "the app keeps forgetting where I am; I'm in Settings, background for one second, come back, it points me to Analysis."

**Why it was reverted:** the nav reset is a genuine **force-stop** effect (proven on the emulator via a full matrix — nav survives warm resume, config-change Activity recreation via `savedInstanceState`, "always finish activities", and the LAUNCHER intent; it resets **only** on a force-stop, since force-stop skips `onSaveInstanceState` → cold start → NavController falls to the home tab, e.g. Analysis). The prompt was built to keep the process alive via a Doze exemption. **On-device it made no difference:** with the exemption *granted*, Alvin still reproduces the reset in <5s (Settings → ~1s background → Analysis). Alvin's Transsion/MTK ROM force-stops via its own OEM task-killer that sits **above** Doze — exactly the caveat flagged when it was booked. So the exemption doesn't earn its cost (a Play-policy-borderline `REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS` permission + a user prompt), especially since **Item 36's widget fixes (esp. G) already make the widget correct on a cold respawn without it** — the widget no longer needs the process kept alive.

**Reverted cleanly:** deleted `core/power/BatteryOptimizationManager.kt` + `feature/settings/data/BatteryOptPromptStore.kt`; `git checkout` restored `SettingsModule`, `PersonalizeViewModel`, `PersonalizeUiState`, `PersonalizeScreen`, and `AndroidManifest.xml` (permission gone) to pre-Item-38 state. `grep` confirms zero battery-opt references remain; `assembleStagingDebug` + `testStagingDebugUnitTest` green.

**Nav reset — accepted ROM limitation (Alvin's call 2026-07-16):** not fixing it for now. The only ROM-independent fix is **persist-and-restore the nav location across force-stop** (recency-gated so a genuine fresh open still lands on the configured home tab). Alvin declined it — the widget is fixed and the reset is tolerable. **If revisited:** this persist-restore approach is the path (touches the nav host `IponAppContent` start destination + the auth/onboarding gate; would want a grill for the app-lock / deep-link / onboarding interactions). Battery-opt is a dead end on this ROM. → **Now being built as Item 39** (2026-07-16 — Alvin reversed the call: "drop everything, I want to fix my #1 item").

## Item 39 — Nav location persist-restore across force-stop (the nav reset, done right)

- **Status:** **DONE `02a247a`** (on-device verified by Alvin, 2026-07-16). Booked 2026-07-16 (design grilled + approved via plan mode same day). **Model: Opus, medium effort** — tiny code surface, but the correctness lives in process-lifecycle edges (force-stop vs. system-saved-state restore; app-lock / onboarding / widget-deeplink interactions). Replaces the **reverted Item 38** (battery-opt was a dead end on the OEM killer). No Room/schema change (stays **v25**). Full design: `~/.claude/plans/drop-everything-i-want-eventual-puffin.md`.
- **Request:** Alvin — "the app keeps forgetting where I am; I go to Settings, background for ~1 second, come back, and it points me to Analysis. My expectation is that I'd be back in Settings." Overturns the 2026-07-16 "accepted / unfixed" call ("drop everything, I want to fix my #1 item").

**Root cause (proven 2026-07-16, memory `rom-force-stop-nav-reset`):** the Transsion/MTK ROM force-stops the backgrounded process within ~1–5s; force-stop skips `onSaveInstanceState`, so the nav shell's `startDestination` (`rememberSaveable` — wiped by force-stop) cold-starts on the home tab (Analysis). Keeping the process alive (Item 38's Doze exemption) can't work — the OEM killer sits **above** Doze. The only ROM-independent fix is **persist-and-restore the last location to disk**, recency-gated.

**Grilled decisions (settled):** **module/tab-level** restore — lands on the module root, reusing the Item 33 `switchTab(NavRegistry.byId[id])` seam ([IponApp.kt:181](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/navigation/IponApp.kt#L181)); exact-screen restore rejected as fragile (arg-routes like `edit_transaction/{id}`, mid-edit editors, back-stack rebuild). **5-minute recency window** (`RESTORE_WINDOW_MS = 300_000`) so a genuine fresh open still lands on the configured home tab.

**Change:**
- **New:** [`navigation/NavStateStore.kt`](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/navigation/NavStateStore.kt) — a `nav_state_prefs` DataStore mirroring [`LastActiveUserStore`](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/session/LastActiveUserStore.kt); `SavedNavLocation(moduleId, backgroundedAt)` + `read`/`save`/`clear`. [`navigation/NavRestorePolicy.kt`](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/navigation/NavRestorePolicy.kt) — pure `moduleToRestore(saved, homeModuleId, now, windowMs, isKnownModule)`.
- **VM:** [`NavbarViewModel`](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/navigation/NavbarViewModel.kt) — inject the store; `rememberLocation(moduleId?)` (persist at ON_STOP with `SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()`) + `suspend moduleToRestore(homeModuleId)` (read store → policy).
- **Shell:** [`navigation/IponApp.kt`](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/navigation/IponApp.kt) — `IponApp` resolves the cold-start target **before the NavHost mounts** (`isColdStart && no deep-link → moduleToRestore(startRoute) ?: home`, gated behind the existing spinner) and passes it as the NavHost **start destination**, so a restore opens **directly** on that tab with **no home-tab flash** (Alvin on-device 2026-07-16 saw a ~0.2s Analysis flash with the first post-mount-`switchTab` approach). `IponAppContent` keeps the `LifecycleEventEffect(ON_STOP)` that captures the current top-level module (null on standalone add/edit-txn / nav-editor). Restore is inherently **skipped** when a widget deep-link launched the app (that path unchanged) and on a system-saved-state recreation (config change / low-memory keeps its own back stack — resolution only runs fresh). **Tradeoff (Alvin's call — "instant, no flash"):** in a restored session the bottom-nav back stack anchors on the restored tab (Back heads there, not home); resets on the next fresh open.
- **Activity:** [`MainActivity.kt`](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/MainActivity.kt) — pass `isColdStart = savedInstanceState == null` (the canonical "no saved state exists" signal — true on force-stop / fresh launch).
- **DI:** [`navigation/NavConfigModule.kt`](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/navigation/NavConfigModule.kt) — provide `nav_state_prefs` + `NavStateStore` (mirror the existing `NavConfigDataStore` qualifier pattern).
- **Sign-out:** [`LocalDataWiper`](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/session/LocalDataWiper.kt) — `navState.clear()` next to `navConfig.reset()` (cross-account hygiene, so account B never restores into account A's last tab).
- **Governs:** ADR-0033 (`switchTab` nested-graph mechanism, reused). Amends the Item 38 "nav reset accepted" note above.
- **Explicitly unchanged:** the auth/onboarding gate (the nav shell only mounts for an onboarded user, so restore is behind it for free), the app-lock Dialog (restore happens under it — no data flash), widget deep-link precedence, no periodic background sync.

**Verify:** tier-1 JVM `NavRestorePolicyTest` (recent-nonhome→id, too-old→null, null→null, unknown-module→null, equals-home→null, boundary(inclusive)→id, negative-delta/reboot→null); `testStagingDebugUnitTest` + `assembleStagingDebug` green. On-device (Alvin, his real force-stopping device — the only place it repros): Settings → home → ~1s → reopen → back in **Settings**; long gap (>5 min) → home tab; PIN set → lock shows on reopen, unlock lands on the restored screen; balance-widget tap from cold → Manage→Accounts (widget wins over restore); sign out → sign in as another test account → that account's home, not the prior tab.

## Item 37 — Confirm-on-arrival recurring + income/bill forecasting

- **Status:** **Slice 1 (free core) `DONE 98c5436`** (2026-07-17, Opus, on-device verified). **Slice 2 (premium forecast layer) `DONE 9e9db99`** (2026-07-17, Opus, on-device verified). Booked 2026-07-16, **grilled 2026-07-16** (15 questions, design settled). **Model: Opus, high effort** — this is a redesign of a load-bearing, tested subsystem (the recurring materialization engine, the app's only auto-writer of transactions), plus new Analysis-forecast + Records surfaces + a new premium gate. Not a pattern-follow. **Schema + Room change: `recurring_rules` gained `auto_post`; Room v25 → v26** (`DONE`, live on staging). **Slice 2 added no schema/Room change (stays v26).**
- **Request (the doorway):** Alvin — *"the user can schedule an upcoming salary, most people get salary every 15 or 30... it's like a recurring income instead of recurring expense,"* and it should help how Analysis shows the data. The grill revealed the real feature underneath: recurring income already works (a rule on an INCOME category materializes an income txn — [MaterializeRecurringRulesUseCase.kt:44](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/domain/usecase/MaterializeRecurringRulesUseCase.kt#L44); the editor already lists income categories — [RecurringScreen.kt:455](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/presentation/RecurringScreen.kt#L455)). What Alvin actually wants is **forward visibility of money coming in/going out, and to never silently record a wrong figure** — which turns into converting the recurring engine from *auto-post* to *confirm-on-arrival*, plus a forecast layer.

**Grilled decisions (each is a settled call, not a suggestion):**
1. **Job to be done (Q1):** forward visibility — *see* money coming in before it lands; **nothing touches the ledger early** (ADR-0007 balance stays strictly derived — reaffirmed, not changed).
2. **Source (Q2):** generic over recurring income — **no new "salary" entity/flag**; derive from existing recurring rules whose category is INCOME. "Salary" is a label, not a concept (CLAUDE.md scalability principle). A friendlier "Add salary" entry point may pre-fill Monthly + an income category but writes a plain `recurring_rules` row.
3. **Payday behavior (Q4/Q5):** **confirm-on-arrival, per-rule.** New field **`auto_post`** on `recurring_rules`: `false` (confirm) is the **default for all new rules** (income *and* bills — Alvin explicitly wanted bills prompted too); `true` (legacy auto-post) is an opt-in for truly-fixed charges. So auto-post is *not* removed — it's demoted to opt-in.
4. **Pending representation (Q6):** **derived — nothing is stored until confirmed.** A confirm-rule (`auto_post=false`) does **not** materialize; its `nextDate` cursor **parks** on the oldest unconfirmed due date. "Pending" = live-computed occurrences from `nextDate`..today. Because nothing exists until confirmed, balance/budget/Analysis exclude it **for free — zero money-query changes.** Sync-safe by construction (deterministic `ruleId:date` UUID → idempotent multi-device confirm; cursor advance is ordinary LWW). **This is the key architectural choice** — rejected the alternative of a `status=pending` column on `transactions` (would force `WHERE status=confirmed` into every balance/budget/Analysis query — wide, error-prone).
5. **Confirm interaction (Q7):** tap a pending prompt → **inline amount tweak** pre-filled with the rule amount (edit ₱20,000 → ₱19,450), then Confirm; account/category/date stay as the rule defines. **Amount tweak applies to that occurrence only (Q15)** — the rule template is unchanged; a permanent raise is a deliberate rule edit.
6. **Confirm = materialize that single occurrence** (deterministic UUID, amount override on the txn only) **+ advance cursor one interval** — literally today's materialization, user-triggered. **Dismiss/Skip = advance cursor without creating** — exactly the existing [SkipNextRecurringOccurrenceUseCase](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/domain/usecase/SkipNextRecurringOccurrenceUseCase.kt).
7. **Pileup (Q8):** one prompt **per occurrence, oldest-first** (three paydays = three distinct events, never merged), each individually confirmable/skippable, **plus "Confirm all" / "Skip all"** bulk actions. A floor auto-skips occurrences older than ~N months so a neglected daily rule can't spawn hundreds (pin **N** at build; propose ~3 months).
8. **Analysis (Q9/Q10):** **projected Net** — shown **alongside** actual Net (never replacing it), **clearly labeled as a forecast** (muted/dashed), **current in-progress month only** (past/multi-month ranges stay pure actuals). Projects **both sides**: `Projected Net = (income received + upcoming scheduled income this month) − (expenses so far + upcoming scheduled bills this month)`. **Cannot see unplanned spend** (inherent — it assumes no more ad-hoc spending; label honestly, don't try to math around it). Replaces the current backward-looking "Last month income" band-aid ([AnalysisUiState.kt:36-41](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/analysis/presentation/AnalysisUiState.kt#L36-L41)) when a schedule exists; falls back to it when none. **Relabel the Flow tab's existing pace-based "projected" figure** to disambiguate from this schedule-based one.
9. **Records (Q11):** a **pinned "To confirm" card** at the top (free — actionable: per-occurrence confirm w/ inline tweak + skip, plus Confirm all/Skip all) **+ a lean "Coming up" preview** (premium — next scheduled income+bills in a short forward window, e.g. next 14 days). Not inline in the day list (a chronological ledger shouldn't scroll up into the future).
10. **Premium (Q12):** **confirm-on-arrival is FREE** (core money-recording — CLAUDE.md "recording your own money is never gated"). **The forecast layer is PREMIUM** — projected Net + the "Coming up" preview — a **new `Feature` gate** (e.g. `RECURRING_FORECAST`) alongside the already-premium `RECURRING_CALENDAR`. Consistent with the existing "forward-looking/deep-insight = premium" line. Dormant per the paywall build stance (kill-switch OFF until Alvin's post-beta go).
11. **Couples (Q13):** **fully personal.** Recurring is owner-only/never-shared; To-confirm prompts, projected Net, and Coming-up are individual-only. **Combined view untouched** — partner income/balances stay redacted (ADR-0004/0011); no household-income forecast (that'd be its own grilled item on the sharing layer).
12. **Notifications (Q14):** **deferred.** No scheduled due-date reminder in this item — pending items are discovered via the Records "To confirm" card on next open. A payday reminder needs new date-scheduled-notification infra (cuts against the foreground-sync philosophy; Item 36 just declined periodic bg sync) and naturally belongs with **[Item 7](#item-7--notification-settings-user-controls-for-alerts-carried-from-v165)** (toggles + `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`). Fast-follow.

**Change (build shape):**
- **Schema (Supabase live via MCP + `supabase/schema.sql`):** `alter table recurring_rules add column auto_post boolean not null default false;` (false = confirm — the new default).
- **Room v25 → v26:** `AutoMigration` adding `autoPost` to [RecurringRuleEntity](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/data/local/RecurringRuleEntity.kt) with default `false`. Sync stack: `auto_post` through [RecurringRuleDto](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/data/remote/RecurringRuleDto.kt) + [RecurringRuleMapper](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/data/RecurringRuleMapper.kt) + [RecurringRuleTableSyncer](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/data/sync/RecurringRuleTableSyncer.kt). Derived pending/upcoming sync nothing new.
- **Domain:** `RecurringRule` gains `autoPost: Boolean`. **[MaterializeRecurringRulesUseCase](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/domain/usecase/MaterializeRecurringRulesUseCase.kt) now processes `auto_post=true` rules only** (confirm rules are left parked). New `ObservePendingConfirmationsUseCase` (derived, `nextDate`..today per confirm-rule, floor-bounded); new `ConfirmOccurrenceUseCase(ruleId, date, amountOverride?)` (materialize single + advance cursor, idempotent); reuse `SkipNextRecurringOccurrenceUseCase` for dismiss; new `ObserveUpcomingUseCase` (future window, income+bills) feeding Coming-up + Analysis. Reuse [RecurringScheduler.occurrencesBetween](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/domain/usecase/RecurringScheduler.kt#L51).
- **Editor UI:** [RecurringScreen](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/presentation/RecurringScreen.kt) gains an **"Auto-post / Ask me to confirm"** per-rule toggle (default confirm).
- **Analysis:** new projected-Net calculator (current-month, both-sides, forecast-labeled) in the analysis domain; wire into the Summary; relabel Flow's pace-projection. Gate on `RECURRING_FORECAST`.
- **Records:** pinned "To confirm" card (free) + "Coming up" preview (premium) in the Records feature.
- **Entitlement:** add `RECURRING_FORECAST` to [Feature.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/entitlement/Feature.kt); wire via `PremiumGate.observeLocked()` (pattern like the recurring calendar). Cross-ref [subscription-paywall-design.md](subscription-paywall-design.md) §10.1 feature map — add the new gate there.
- **ADRs:** **new ADR** for confirm-on-arrival recurring (auto-post → per-rule confirm; derived-pending model; cursor parking; this-occurrence amount override). Amend **ADR-0035** (skip now also serves "dismiss pending"). **Reaffirm ADR-0007** (balance still ledger-derived — pending is never stored). Update CLAUDE.md V1 Scope / recurring notes.
- **Explicitly unchanged:** balance derivation (ADR-0007 — nothing stored early), all money queries (derived-pending needs no `WHERE` change), auto-post rules' behavior (identical to today, just now opt-in), the Combined view, partner redaction.

**Suggested slicing (vertical, per CLAUDE.md — likely ≥2 commits):**
- **Slice 1 (free core — confirm-on-arrival) `DONE 98c5436`:** schema + Room v26 + `auto_post` through the stack + editor toggle + split materialization + `ObservePendingConfirmations`/`ConfirmOccurrence`/`SkipPendingOccurrence` + Records "To confirm" card (per-occurrence + bulk). Ships the safety feature standalone.
- **Slice 2 (premium forecast layer) `DONE 9e9db99`:** `ObserveUpcoming` + Records "Coming up" preview + Analysis projected Net (both-sides, labeled) + `RECURRING_FORECAST` gate + Flow-label disambiguation. Detail below.

**Slice 1 — shipped 2026-07-17 (`98c5436`), on-device verified (emulator; Alvin driving + confirming).** Built mostly to the grilled spec above, with two deliberate refinements found while building, plus a same-session edge-case pass:

- **Confirm does not advance the cursor** (a refinement of decision 6's literal "materialize + advance cursor"): since "pending" is derived by subtracting the *materialized* id set (decision 4) rather than reading the cursor directly, leaving the cursor parked and letting materialization drive exclusion makes an out-of-order confirm (e.g. confirming a later occurrence before an earlier one of the same rule) safe by construction — no occurrence can be silently dropped by a confirm. **Skip** is the operation that advances the cursor.
- **New `SkipPendingOccurrenceUseCase(ruleId, date)`** rather than reusing [SkipNextRecurringOccurrenceUseCase](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/domain/usecase/SkipNextRecurringOccurrenceUseCase.kt): it needs to be **date-aware** (advance past the specific occurrence date shown on the card, regression-guarded) since a confirm rule's cursor can lag behind the floor window — the old use case just steps whatever the rule's current `nextDate` happens to be, which isn't safe here. `SkipNextRecurringOccurrenceUseCase` is untouched (still used by the plain rule-list "skip next").
- **Edge-case pass (same session, before commit):** the card's amount field bypassed the global Privacy mode (Item 15) in an early draft — fixed so it renders through `money()`/masks like the rest of the app, and each row's eye (kept in its original per-row position, not centralized) writes through the same global `SetPrivacyModeUseCase` flag rather than a local reveal, so any row's tap masks/reveals every amount app-wide. Also: **Skip is only offered on each rule's oldest pending row** (`skippableOccurrenceIds`) — since Skip moves a single cursor, offering it on a later occurrence while an earlier one of the same rule is still pending would silently strand the earlier one; Confirm has no such restriction (order-independent by construction, per the point above).
- **Outstanding doc debt:** the new ADR for confirm-on-arrival recurring (auto-post → per-rule confirm; derived-pending model; cursor-parks-on-confirm/advances-on-skip; this-occurrence amount override) and the ADR-0035 amendment ("skip" now also serves dismiss-pending) called for in the original plan above were **not yet written** — flagged here rather than silently skipped; do before/alongside Slice 2 or on Alvin's call.
+37 tier-1 JVM tests (`ObservePendingConfirmationsUseCaseTest`, `ConfirmOccurrenceUseCaseTest`, `SkipPendingOccurrenceUseCaseTest`, `SkippableOccurrenceIdsTest`, `ParseConfirmAmountTest`, `RecurringSchedulerFirstOccurrenceTest`, mapper round-trip, materialize-auto-only); `testStagingDebugUnitTest` + `assembleStagingDebug` green. **On-device (emulator, Alvin driving + confirming):** editor "Post automatically" toggle (off by default, correct copy both states); a confirm rule's Records card shows "Income due"/"Bill due" correctly; confirm with an inline amount tweak posts the tweaked amount while the rule template stays unchanged and the cursor stays parked (DB-verified); skip advances the cursor and posts nothing (DB-verified); an `auto_post=true` rule still posts silently with no card; a 3-occurrence card correctly gated Skip to the oldest row only, and skipping it correctly promoted the next occurrence to "oldest" without stranding it; the global privacy eye (tapped from any row) revealed/hid the card's amounts together with the transaction list below.

**Slice 2 — shipped 2026-07-17 (`9e9db99`, Opus, on-device verified).** The premium forecast layer on top of Slice 1's free confirm-on-arrival core. Built to the grilled spec (decisions 8/9/10):

- **`UpcomingOccurrence` + `ObserveUpcomingUseCase`** (recurring domain) — the forward view: **derived** future occurrences in `(today, windowEnd]`, sibling to `ObservePendingConfirmationsUseCase` but three ways different — **forward-only** (strictly after today, so it never overlaps the ledger or the "To confirm" list), covers **all** non-paused rules (`auto_post` true *and* false — a forecast doesn't care whether the eventual record is silent or confirmed), and needs **no materialized-id exclusion** (a future occurrence is never materialized yet). Callers pick the horizon via a `windowEnd: (today) -> LocalDate` lambda.
- **Records "Coming up" preview (premium)** — new `ComingUpViewModel`/`ComingUpUiState`/`ComingUpCard`, hosted alongside `PendingConfirmationsViewModel` on Records (same self-contained `hiltViewModel()`-internally pattern), pinned **below** the "To confirm" card. Window = next **14 days**, capped to **5 rows**. Self-hides when empty. When **unlocked** (dormant/premium) it's a read-only list of upcoming income (+) / bills (−); when **locked** (`RECURRING_FORECAST` enforced without access) it degrades to a **count-only upsell teaser** — "N upcoming items — see your income & bills ahead with Premium" — that routes to the paywall (logs `upsell_tap` source `recurring_forecast`), never revealing the amounts.
- **Analysis month-end projected Net (premium)** — new pure `ProjectedNetCalculator` (analysis domain): `projectedNet = actualNet + upcoming income this month − upcoming bills this month`, both sides, **current in-progress month only** (past/other ranges drop it), labeled a forecast ("Projected month-end net: X" + "Forecast — assumes no other spending"). It **replaces the "Last month income" band-aid when a schedule exists** and falls back to it when none (`hasSchedule` gates it). Wired into `AnalysisViewModel` via a new outer `.combine(observeUpcoming { end-of-current-month })`, reusing the existing `individualLocked` seam (RECURRING_FORECAST is the same individual scope as the S10 Analysis gates). When locked, the Summary shows a tappable "🔒 See your projected month-end net — Premium" teaser instead of the value. **Flow's pace-based "Projected" metric was relabeled "At this pace"** to disambiguate the two projections.
- **`RECURRING_FORECAST`** added to `Feature.kt` (catalogue entry; actual gating is the scope-based `observeLocked(INDIVIDUAL)` seam) + to [subscription-paywall-design.md](subscription-paywall-design.md) §10.1. Still **dormant** — `observeLocked` is always false with enforcement OFF, so both surfaces show fully pre-flip (byte-identical to no gate).
- **ADR-0007 reaffirmed by construction** — the forecast is a pure add-on to the already-derived actual Net; nothing is stored, no money-query changes.
- **Tests:** +8 tier-1 JVM cases — `ObserveUpcomingUseCaseTest` (future income+bills, today-excluded, past-excluded, window-end trim, auto-post-included, paused-excluded, missing-category, oldest-first merge) + `ProjectedNetCalculatorTest` (both-sides, month-end trim, no-schedule=actual, income-only). `testStagingDebugUnitTest` (**993 total**) + `assembleStagingDebug` green.
- **Outstanding doc debt (still open from Slice 1):** the new ADR for confirm-on-arrival recurring + the ADR-0035 amendment ("skip" also serves dismiss-pending) remain unwritten — flagged, on Alvin's call.

**On-device verified 2026-07-17 (emulator Medium_Phone AVD, Claude driving, real paired staging couple — both free).** Created a ₱5,000 Salary (income) rule due Jul 25 + a ₱2,000 Electricity (bill) rule due Jul 28 (today Jul 17). **Unlocked (dormant):** the Records "Coming up" card listed both (Salary Income due Jul 25 **+₱5,000**, Electricity Bill due Jul 28 **−₱2,000**, read-only, correct income+/bill− colours); the card self-hid when no rule was upcoming (before adding + after deleting); the Analysis Summary showed **"Projected month-end net: ₱20,916.00"** — exactly the actual Net ₱17,916 + 5,000 − 2,000, both sides — with "Forecast — assumes no other spending", replacing "Last month income"; the Flow metric read **"At this pace"** (coexisting with the schedule-based projection). **Locked (temporary staging `enforcement_enabled` flip ON, refreshed via full sync):** the "Coming up" card degraded to a **count-only teaser** ("2 upcoming items — see your income & bills ahead with Premium", **no amounts leaked**), the Summary showed **"🔒 See your projected month-end net — Premium"**, and both tapped through to the Premium paywall; the free "To confirm" card stayed fully functional. **Restored:** enforcement flipped back OFF (remote + local cache dormant), both test rules deleted + pushed to staging.

## Item 23 — Archived entity label fallback in Records & Budgets (⏸️ DEFERRED — needs tester feedback)

- **Status:** ⏸️ **DEFERRED** — moved here from [v1.6.5.md](v1.6.5.md) Item 23 (2026-07-14). Booked but intentionally **not scheduled**; Alvin wants **tester feedback first** before deciding whether it's a bug to fix or the intended signal. Split out of [v1.6.5.md Item 19](v1.6.5.md) to keep that slice tightly scoped. **Model (if built): Sonnet, low effort.** Non-paywall.
- **Independent** — pure display-time label resolution, no schema/sync/data change.

**Surfaced 2026-07-11** while confirming Item 19's archive semantics. Records and Budgets resolve a category/account **name from its id** via a lookup map built from `observeCategories()` / `observeAccounts()` at the default `includeArchived = false`. So a **historical row pointing at a now-archived entity** drops out of the map and falls back to a generic label:
- **Records list** ([TransactionsViewModel.toListItem](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/transactions/presentation/TransactionsViewModel.kt#L161)) — a transaction whose **category** was archived reads **"Uncategorized"** (`categoryNames[categoryId] ?: "Uncategorized"`); whose **account** was archived reads **"Account"** (`accountNames[accountId] ?: "Account"`).
- **Budgets** ([BudgetsViewModel](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/budgets/presentation/BudgetsViewModel.kt#L78)) — an existing budget on a now-archived category reads **"Category"** (`categoryNames[it] ?: "Category"`); the budget still tracks spending correctly, only the name degrades.

**The inconsistency:** [Analysis](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/analysis/presentation/AnalysisViewModel.kt#L83) deliberately observes `includeArchived = true` so archived categories **keep their label** in the donut/flow; Recurring materialization does the same. Records and Budgets never got that treatment, so the **same archived category is labeled three different ways** depending on the screen. It is **purely cosmetic** — no data loss (the row still carries its `categoryId`/`accountId`), and **unarchiving restores every label instantly** (the entity re-enters the map).

**The product question to answer with tester feedback (why it's deferred, not just built):** is an archived category *supposed* to keep naming its old transactions in Records (consistent with Analysis), or is **"Uncategorized"** the intended cue that "this category is retired"? Don't change the behavior until this is decided.

**If built (the shape):** Records is a one-line switch to `observeCategories(includeArchived = true)` / `observeAccounts(includeArchived = true)` (it uses the list only for label lookup, not a picker). Budgets is a **two-line split** — build the label map from an archived-inclusive observe, but keep the **new-budget picker** (`expenseCategories = categories.filter { it.type == EXPENSE }`) filtered to **active** categories so archived ones don't reappear as budgetable options. (The Add-Transaction / Quick-add / Recurring-editor pickers stay `false` — archived items must not be offered for *new* activity.)

**Verify (if built):** archive a category with existing transactions + a budget → Records rows keep the real name (not "Uncategorized"), the budget row keeps its name (not "Category"), Analysis unchanged; the archived category does **not** appear in the Add-Transaction picker or the new-budget picker; unarchive → everything unchanged.
